title: Related Resources
content:
Probability Links Problem Solutions: Solutions to Problems in the Textbook (PDF)
MathPages: Probability and Statistics - A sampling of classic problems in probability and statistics.
The Normal Distribution - Tutorial A tutorial on the Normal or Gaussian distribution.
MATLAB® Probability Tutorial - MATLAB® programs dealing mostly with random variables
The Applied Probability Trust - The home page for the non-profit foundation that publishes the Journal of Applied Probability and Advances in Applied Probability.
The Layman’s Guide to Probability Theory - An easily readable guide that covers various aspects of probability theory, with a bias to gambling games.
Math for Morons Like Us–Algebra II: Probability - A brief tutorial, focusing mainly on the topic of counting.
Common Probability Distributions - A Compendium which covers numbers of useful distributions for modeling of random data.
Al Drake’s Book Table of Contents (PDF)
Chapter 1 - Events, Sample Space, and Probability (PDF - 1.0 MB)
Chapter 2 - Random Variables (PDF - 1.3 MB)
Chapter 3 - Transforms and Some Applications to Sums of Independent Random Variables (PDF)
Chapter 4 - Some Basic Probabilistic Processes (PDF - 1.2 MB)
Chapter 5 - Discrete-state Markov Processes (PDF - 1.3 MB)
Chapter 6 - Some Fundamental Limit Theorems (PDF)
Chapter 7 - An Introduction to Statistics (PDF)
Appendix (PDF)
